title: Brain Board
description: A live class quiz board: pick a tile from a category, and its question opens on every device at once. Bigger tiles are harder and worth more, and a hidden Lucky Star doubles the points. Played alone, it is a practice board of sums.
notes: Oomba Live built-in mode 'board', 2D on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 with the live pack. The server owns the board (shared state bb: categories, tile values and states, the open tile, whose pick it is; server/services/classlive-board.js) and the scoring (tile value plus up to 20% for speed, doubled on a Lucky Star, never minus points). The game draws it: the projector picks tiles (L.send('pick', {c, r})) and toggles players picking (L.send('turns', {on})); with turns on, the fastest right answer picks next from their phone (L.send('pick', ..., {toHost: true}); word 'pick'). Uses Oomba.live ready({lobby, quiz, hostView, teams, words}), the state / question / answers / reveal / result / leaderboard / end events, quiz.answer and flat() (lobby, scores, podium). Played alone: a 5x5 practice board of sums. Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state(), pick(c, r), answer(i), turns().
